issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal): the problem statement instructs "For easier testing, make sure to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public" (problem statement requires a public method). In the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) the method is declared as private and the parameter is commented out (private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)), and in the provided solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) the method is also declared private (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). This inconsistency prevents external tests or students from calling the helper method as requested by the problem statement and can cause tests that expect a public helper to fail or confuse students about the required visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method signature publicly accessible to match the problem statement: declare it as public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) in the template. Update the solution accordingly or update the problem statement/tests to expect a private helper if making it public is not intended. Also ensure the template method includes the Animal parameter (remove the commented-out parameter) so the signature exactly matches: public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal).
